queries: LLM hallucination rate compared with human expert baseline benchmark 2024

sources_considered.why: FaithBench (October 2024) measures model hallucination against human-annotated labels, not against a human-expert error rate.
MedHalu (September 2024) measures detection of hallucinations by experts, not an expert hallucination rate.

unresolved_gaps: No source read for this record measures how often human experts make factual errors on the same tasks as the 2024 models, so the comparison the forecast names cannot be made.
The speaker named no task or domain, so any baseline chosen would be our interpretation.
